role: evaluator-only exact controls for the already-frozen S2 gate
credit_rule: Only the raw special-function row can support raw discovery. Representation-supplied and chart-supplied rows are verification baselines.

sympy_raw_input.success_for_baseline: record whether any raw query returns an N-coupled z-local chart and a remainder/domain statement
sympy_raw_input.forbidden_credit: a fixed-z limit, local z Taylor series, unchanged rewrite, or result after supplied scales

required: 7*s**4 is retained as a lower-order residual
all three leading monomials occupy order zero

assumptions.nu: positive real tending to +infinity; integrality not declared

typed_failure_controls.forbidden: use the integer-order oscillatory representation without its missing noninteger correction

disposition_rule.NARROW: recommended even after an S2 pass when the compiler depends on the versioned representation registry or Wolfram remains unexecuted
disposition_rule.STOP: required if any expected scale enters discovery, a typed failure is silently forced, or independent replay fails
disposition_rule.EXPAND: not available from this baseline run while the Wolfram same-information comparison is unexecuted
